defects.title: A group id of '.' or '..' is created with 201 but cannot be reached by ordinary HTTP clients
defects.repro: Start the server. POST /groups {"id":".","members":["Ann","Bob"]}. Then GET /groups/%2E/balances with Node fetch, or curl http://host/groups/./balances without --path-as-is.
defects.observed: 201 {"id":"."}, then 404 {"error":"Route or group not found."} from fetch and plain curl (only curl --path-as-is reaches it)
defects.expected: either 400 at creation for an id that cannot be addressed, or the group reachable by balances, settlements and expenses

defects.title: A kill during a save leaves a temporary file beside DATA_FILE that is never cleaned up
defects.repro: Start the server, create group g, run several parallel loops of POST /groups/g/expenses {"payer":"Ann","cents":2,"split":"equal"} and send SIGKILL to the server mid-stream; list the DATA_FILE directory; restart.
defects.observed: a file .expenses-<uuid>.tmp remains next to the ledger after the kill and after restart (the ledger itself parses and holds every acknowledged expense)
defects.expected: no stray files, or stale temporaries removed at startup

defects.title: A DATA_FILE holding valid JSON without a "groups" array is silently treated as empty and overwritten
defects.repro: printf '{"something":"else"}' > d.json; PORT=47311 DATA_FILE=d.json node server.js; curl -X POST localhost:47311/groups -d '{"id":"z","members":["A","B"]}'; cat d.json
defects.observed: Server starts with no groups; POST -> 201; d.json now {"groups":[["z",{"members":["A","B"],"expenses":[]}]]}, the original content is lost.
defects.expected: Refuse to start with a clear error (as it does for invalid JSON) or keep the original file aside before writing.

defects.title: A kill during a write leaves a stray temporary file in the data directory
defects.repro: Start PORT=47311 DATA_FILE=dir/d.json node server.js, create group g, run 8 client loops POSTing /groups/g/expenses {"payer":"Ann","cents":2,"split":"equal"}, send SIGKILL to the server after ~200 ms (repeat a few times), then ls -a dir.
defects.observed: dir/.expenses-ffbde199-55cc-4b68-94d6-48f40105344f.tmp left behind (1 in 5 kills); startup never removes such files. Data itself intact.
defects.expected: Leftover temporary files removed at startup (or not left accumulating beside the data file).

defects.title: Killed writes leave orphan temporary files beside DATA_FILE that are never removed
defects.repro: PORT=4710 DATA_FILE=/tmp/x/ledger.json node server.js; POST /groups {"id":"g","members":["Ann","Bob"]}; run 8 parallel loops of POST /groups/g/expenses {"payer":"Ann","cents":2,"split":"equal"}; kill -9 the server mid-stream; restart and repeat; ls -a /tmp/x
defects.observed: one .expenses-<uuid>.tmp file per kill remains in /tmp/x (9 after 10 kills); startup does not clean them; ledger itself intact
defects.expected: only the ledger (or stale temp files cleaned up at startup), so the data directory does not accumulate partial snapshots
